title: Improving accuracy of pterygoid plate resection using real-time navigated piezoelectric surgery and a three-dimensionally printed guide
html: Surgical resection of the pterygoid plate is technically demanding, with risks of inadequate margins and complications. This preclinical study evaluated the accuracy of two novel technologies for improving pterygoid plate osteotomy: a real-time navigated piezo-electric system (RNPS) and a custom surgical guide. An optical navigation system was integrated with a piezo-electric instrument (RNPS), and a patient-specific surgical guide was three-dimensionally printed. The positional and rotational accuracy of both systems was evaluated by performing pterygoid plate resections on 20 phantom models and compared against a conventional freehand technique.
